description.value: Chun Fun How is a Taiwanese bubble tea and specialty beverage shop grounded in values of heritage, authenticity, and devotion to quality Taiwanese ingredients. The West Broadway location offers an extensive menu spanning milk teas, fresh milk teas, fruit teas, and seasonal creations featuring osmanthus, purple yam, wintermelon, aloe vera, and lychee. The shop also offers office catering with large-format 3L drink boxes, reflecting a community-oriented, neighbourhood presence.

concerns: OSM record had no phone number; Vancouver location phone (604) 336-6922 was sourced from the website catering subpage only.
